A  is a popular business structure that provides limited liability, separate legal identity, and continuity of business. It is widely preferred by startups and growing businesses due to its structured ownership and credibility. This guide covers the key benefits, eligibility, registration process, and documents required.
Benefits of Registering a Private Limited Company
Shareholders’ liability is generally limited to their shareholding, subject to applicable laws.
The company has a legal identity separate from its shareholders and can own property, enter contracts, and conduct business in its own name.
A structured corporate entity can provide greater opportunities to raise funds from investors and financial institutions.
The company continues to exist despite changes in ownership or management.
The company may claim applicable deductions and tax benefits under prevailing tax laws.
Eligibility Criteria for Private Limited Company Registration
To register a Private Limited Company in India, the following requirements generally apply:

The company must have a registered office address in India.
There is no prescribed minimum paid-up capital requirement, subject to applicable laws.
